author: Oldboyjay
quote:
One point because the environment looks nice.
 -9 points because: 
1. The game is capped at 30 frames.
2. The protagonist is dumb and boring.
3. The story is badly written.
4. I can’t kill protesters or kids
5. Combat is unimaginative and sometimes broken.
6. Game interactions are poorly executed and cause severe collisions that sometimes crash the game.
7. The hot women aren’t hot enough. We need more fit and beautiful white women with big tiddies. Less Latino’s with flat chests. (Happy with hotter big tiddy Latinos). 
8. Character creation and clothing choices are a bit gay.
9. After 50 hours of gameplay. I’m still stuck, wondering what the point of it all was. It wasn’t even fun. Just another grind for trophy’s nobody cares about.


7. In the past, some of the best parts about GTA was the ability FAFO. In this game, the ou are very limited in what you are able to do outside of the games narrative.
